# Vault UI

> Vault UI is a premium React + Tailwind component line: 100+ components across seven kits plus five dashboard templates, unified by one token engine (soft-ui, aether, paper, parchment, and more).

## About

Vault UI ships dependency-light components driven by a single design-token system. It is built as a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo (`apps/web` SPA, `packages/*` for ui, tokens, utils, data-viz, marketing, ai-chat, collab, commerce). The app is a static Vite/React SPA on Vercel backed by Supabase (auth, Postgres, RLS) — no custom backend.

## Key pages

- https://vault-ui.vercel.app/ — product landing page (kits, licensing, install)
- https://vault-ui.vercel.app/sign-in — account sign-in
- https://vault-ui.vercel.app/sign-up — account sign-up
- https://vault-ui.vercel.app/docs — component vault (auth required)

## Notes for AI agents

- The docs vault, projects, and kit sharing require a user account.
- Component sources live in the repo (`apps/web/src/docs/registry*.tsx`).
